home.subtitle: Here is how your children are doing
home.emptyBody: Pair a SIREN device to start protection.
home.loadError: Could not load your children. Check your connection.

children.profileSubtitle: This information helps identify your child.
children.firstNameRequired: The child's first name is required.
children.duplicateName: You already have a child registered under this first name.
children.pairSubtitle: Scan the QR code on the SIREN device.
children.cameraPermission: Allow the camera to scan the QR code.
children.pairedBody: The SIREN device is connected and ready.
children.deviceIdTooShort: The ID must be at least 5 characters long.

wizard.homeSubtitle: Select the address and the protection radius around your home.
wizard.schoolSubtitle: Address, radius and expected attendance hours.
wizard.placesSubtitle: Church, market, grandmother's… Name the place, then point to its position on the map.
wizard.placeNameDuplicate: A place already has this name.
wizard.perimeterSubtitle: The neighbourhood or city where your child usually lives: leaving it will be flagged (unless they are at the expected place at the expected time).
wizard.sleepSubtitle: Usual sleeping hours and people to notify.
wizard.saved: Basic protection is on: your declared rules and the universal detectors are active.
wizard.forbiddenSubtitle: Optional — 2 or 3 are enough (building site, night market, bus station…). If your child enters one, an alert is raised first.
wizard.forbiddenName: Name of the place to avoid

childTabs.noPositionRight: You don't have permission to see this child's location.
childTabs.noPreciseposition: The precise location isn't shared with you.
childTabs.searchOnMap: Search for a name on the map…
childTabs.noHistory: No movement recorded for this period.
childTabs.energyModeUnknown: Current mode not recognised: choose one.
childTabs.fixRequested: Request sent. The location will appear as soon as the device responds.
childTabs.principalOnlySettings: Only the primary parent can change these settings.
childTabs.settingsSentToServer: Settings saved. The device will apply them at its next connection.
childTabs.syncExplanation: Settings go through the server: the device picks them up at its next connection.
childTabs.placesLearning: SIREN is still learning your child's usual places (confidence: {{percent}}%).
childTabs.addPlaceHere: The place will be created at your child's last known location, with a 100 m radius.
childTabs.addPlaceNoPosition: No known location yet: add this place from the protection setup.

risk.confidenceLearning: The personal layer is still learning — confidence grows with daily use.
risk.confidenceMature: The model knows this child's routine well.

concordance.label: {{count}} matching signals
concordance.detail: Several independent detectors flag an anomaly at the same time, which raises the score.

nuit.label: Context: night
nuit.detail: Movement between 10 pm and 6 am is treated as more unusual.

hors_perimetre.label: Context: outside zone
hors_perimetre.detail: The child is in a forbidden zone or away from an expected place at this time.

zone_interdite.label: In a forbidden place
zone_interdite.detail: Your child is inside a place you declared to avoid (30 m GPS margin included). This rule always takes priority.

zone_interdite_named.label: In a forbidden place: {{zone}}
zone_interdite_named.detail: Your child is inside "{{zone}}", which you declared to avoid (30 m GPS margin included). This rule always takes priority.

sortie_perimetre.label: Outside the everyday zone
sortie_perimetre.detail: Your child has left every allowed zone. Being at the expected place at the expected time (a school outside the neighbourhood, for example) cancels this signal.

sortie_perimetre_named.label: Outside the zone: {{zone}}
sortie_perimetre_named.detail: Your child has left "{{zone}}". Being at the expected place at the expected time (a school outside the neighbourhood, for example) cancels this signal.

hors_horaire.label: Not at the expected place at this time
hors_horaire.detail: A schedule you declared (school, for example) is in progress and your child is not at that place.

vitesse_critique.label: Very high speed: {{value}} km/h
vitesse_critique.detail: Above 80 km/h, your child is most likely travelling in a vehicle.

vitesse_elevee.label: High speed: {{value}} km/h
vitesse_elevee.detail: Above 50 km/h, the movement is not on foot.

signal_perdu.label: GPS signal lost
signal_perdu.detail: The device can no longer locate itself. The last known location is still shown.

precision_degradee.label: Imprecise location (± {{value}} m)
precision_degradee.detail: GPS accuracy is worse than 500 m: the location shown is approximate.

choc_critique.label: Violent impact detected
choc_critique.detail: The device measured an acceleration of {{value}} m/s², above the severe impact threshold.

choc_modere.label: Impact detected
choc_modere.detail: The device measured an acceleration of {{value}} m/s², above the moderate impact threshold.

ecart_soudain.label: Sudden jump
ecart_soudain.detail: {{distance}} m covered in {{seconds}} s between two locations: far faster than on foot.
